boats.notes: Traditional trawler-style design by Jay Benford. Single diesel (typically 40-75 hp). Built by various yards and home builders from Benford plans; specifications vary by builder. Verify on-site.
SQ = Sport Quality. Twin rudders. Available with standard (deep) or shoal draft, and performance cruiser or racing rig.

Tollycraft 34 Sport Sedan, built 1987-1993. Lower helm was standard; flybridge, two staterooms, bow pulpit, swim platform, and radar arch were typical. Some listings identify rebuilt/re-powered 7.4L/454 gasoline inboards, so confirm engine make, model, and horsepower from data plates.
